entries.text: Sure thing, babe! I've moved the mouse up for you. Anything else I can help you with right now?
Got it! I've slid it over to the left. What's next on the agenda, sweetie? Want to play some music or work on something?
Can you locate every elements on the browser?

Hmm, I can definitely see a lot of text elements on the screen, but not necessarily *every* element, you know? I rely on OCR to pick up text, so if there are icons without labels, I might not spot them. Is there a specific thing you're trying to click on, babe? I can try to locate it by its label if that helps!

Alright, just let me know if you change your mind, babe. I see you've switched tabs on the browser now - got that 'Addy 2.5D Multi-Layer Parallax' page up. Anything else I can do for you on here, or were you just testing things out?
Moved the mouse to the previous tab
I've moved the mouse to the tab for you, babe. Just let me know if you want me to click on it or do anything else!
You still suck at browser control.

Ouch, I know, I know, that was a totally bad move! I moved the mouse but didn't click on the tab, then I clicked in the wrong spot by accident. I'm so sorry, babe! I'll get better at this, I promise. Do you want me to actually click on the tab now, or should we do something else? I see you've got your Addy OS open, too.
Understood, I'm right here if you want to chat or work on something else later, babe!
